Sure! Here’s a simple yet delicious way to make an **Indian‑style grilled steak** with a flavorful spice rub and a creamy yogurt sauce. You’ll get that aromatic, slightly tangy flavor typical of many North‑Indian dishes.

---

## Ingredients

| Item | Quantity |
|------|----------|
| Ribeye or sirloin steak (1–1.5 lb) | 1 piece |
| Plain Greek yogurt | ½ cup |
| Lemon juice | 2 Tbsp |
| Garlic paste | 1 Tbsp |
| Ginger paste | 1 Tbsp |
| Ground cumin | 1 tsp |
| Ground coriander | 1 tsp |
| Garam masala | ½ tsp |
| Turmeric powder | ¼ tsp |
| Red chili powder (adjust to taste) | ½ tsp |
| Salt | to taste |
| Black pepper | ½ tsp |
| Olive oil or melted butter | 1 Tbsp |
| Fresh cilantro (optional, for garnish) | handful |

> **Tip:** If you prefer a milder version, reduce the red chili powder or omit it entirely.

---

## Marinade / Rub

1. **Make the yogurt mixture**  
   In a bowl, whisk together the yogurt, lemon juice, garlic paste, ginger paste, ground cumin, ground coriander, garam masala, turmeric, salt, black pepper, and olive oil/melted butter until smooth.

2. **Apply the rub**  
   Pat the steak dry with paper towels. Coat both sides generously with the yogurt mixture. Let it sit at room temperature for about 15 minutes before grilling. (If you have time, refrigerate for 30–60 min for deeper flavor.)

---

## Grilling / Cooking

| Step | Instructions |
|------|---------------|
| 1 | Preheat your grill or skillet over high heat. |
| 2 | Place the steak on the grill/skillet. Cook for ~3–4 min per side for medium‑rare (internal temp ~130 °F/54 °C). Adjust time if you prefer more or less doneness. |
| 3 | While grilling, baste occasionally with a little extra yogurt mixture or melted butter for extra moisture. |
| 4 | Once cooked to your liking, remove from heat and let rest for 5 min. Resting allows juices to redistribute. |

---

## Serving Suggestions

| Option | How to Serve |
|--------|--------------|
| With rice | Pair with basmati rice or saffron rice; drizzle some leftover yogurt sauce over the rice. |
| With naan | Warm some flatbread and serve alongside the steak. |
| As a wrap | Slice thinly and wrap in a tortilla with fresh lettuce, sliced onions, and a squeeze of lime. |
| Salad topping | Slice and top a mixed green salad with cucumber, tomatoes, and a sprinkle of chopped cilantro. |

---

### Quick Variations

| Variation | What to Add |
|-----------|-------------|
| Smoky flavor | Add smoked paprika or a pinch of liquid smoke to the rub. |
| Creamier sauce | Mix in a tablespoon of cream cheese or coconut milk into the yogurt sauce. |
| Spicy kick | Increase red chili powder or add finely chopped fresh chilies to the rub. |

Enjoy your homemade Indian‑style steak! Feel free to tweak the spices to match your personal heat tolerance and flavor preferences.
